thread:
jess_partners: Heads-up — planning a hands-on enablement session for Nimbus marketplace partners (45min). Goal: ship a paired reference architecture + reusable Terraform modules and a lightweight validation harness they can run locally. Who can help run the lab?

mike_eng: count me in for the infra demo. i'd like to walk through a simple module pattern and a tiny smoke test that does terraform apply -> run a basic inference request. keeps it concrete.

anya_docs: i'll assemble the partner-facing README + checklist: env vars, provider pins, example variables, and how to submit the package to the marketplace portal. will include a troubleshooting FAQ.

dylan_infra: i'll own the CI template and the validation harness (GH Actions + a local runner). plan: a PR triggers lint -> terrascan -> terraform init/plan (no apply) -> optional smoke job on partner sandbox.

alex_partner: from partner side we're happy to join. request: make the modules tiny and opinionated (network, storage, runtime) so they can plug into our existing infra. also a section on how to map our IAM roles to module variables would help.

sara_pm: timing: tentatively Wed 9am PT. partners to RSVP by Monday. deliverables before session: repo skeleton + example module + CI workflow + quickstart doc. can we hit that?

mike_eng: doable if we keep one reference flow and one advanced appendix. i'll draft the module conventions doc tonight.

dylan_infra: CI snippet for the workshop (we'll paste in slides):
```yaml
name: module-validate
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y unzip
          curl -fsSL -o tf.zip https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.5.0/terraform_1.5.0_linux_amd64.zip
          unzip tf.zip && sudo mv terraform /usr/local/bin/
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -d . -o cli -p policies/
      - name: TF Init & Plan
        run: terraform init && terraform plan -input=false
```

ci-bot: Workflow created: partners/module-validate (automated).

anya_docs: i'll add a "common validation failures" table: provider/API quotas, missing tags, bad variable types. short fixes for each.

jess_partners: also include a tiny on-prem note: if a partner needs to vendor modules internally, show how to point modules to a private registry and run the same CI. make it a single paragraph in the README.

alex_partner: perfect. could we also provide a couple of knob suggestions for Nimbus hardware (fp16 vs int8, batch size defaults) as an appendix? our infra team will appreciate that.

mike_eng: yes — appendix only. keep core quickstart hardware-agnostic.

sara_pm: action list: 1) create repo skeleton under redwood-partners/marketplace-labs (dylan) 2) draft quickstart README (anya) 3) module convention doc + sample module (mike) 4) CI workflow + terrascan baseline (dylan). deliverables Mon EOD. reconvene Tue 10am to verify.

jess_partners: thanks everyone — i'll send invites and the RSVP form. we'll keep the workshop focused and follow up with a working PR that partners can fork. :rocket:
